- **No News / Zero Articles Found:** Thin news environment amplifies technicals and options flow — moves can be sharper but also more reversible on any surprise headline (AI regulation, China export controls on semiconductors — a recurring NVDA risk).

- **52W High Proximity ($236.54, +5% away):** A catalyst could trigger breakout above all-time range highs — this would invalidate any short thesis rapidly.

---

| **15m VWAP** | $225.86 | Must reclaim for bull intraday structure to recover |
| **1H VWAP** | $223.81 | Bull/bear pivot for intraday direction |
| **Near Support** | $220-$221 | EMA9 daily cluster; first meaningful bid zone |
| **Key Support** | $212.50 | EMA50 daily; breakdown below this changes trend thesis |
| **Thesis Change Level** | $228+ close | Reclaim above $227.98 on volume invalidates bear setup entirely |
